_about: Hand-compiled list of organizations helping Palisades fire survivors. Descriptions are written in our own words; each entry links to the organization and to the source we used. Programs, addresses, and hours change: confirm with each organization. Not affiliated with any organization listed.

organizations.name: Palisades Towne Hall
organizations.description: An outdoor community gathering space and marketplace in Pacific Palisades that hosts events. Its profits go toward rebuilding the Palisades.

organizations.name: Palisades Long Term Recovery Group
organizations.description: Connects fire survivors to relief money and support, including disaster case management and help applying for recovery grants. Focuses on residents who need extra help, such as seniors and underinsured homeowners.
organizations.source_title: Palisades News: Pali Leaders Launch Relief Organization (Aug 2025)

organizations.name: Palisades Recovery Coalition
organizations.description: A community coalition working on a plan for how the Palisades rebuilds, presented to the Pacific Palisades Community Council.
organizations.source_title: Palisadian-Post: Palisades Recovery Coalition presents draft plan

organizations.name: Steadfast LA
organizations.description: A nonprofit founded by Rick Caruso in February 2025 to speed up rebuilding in fire-affected areas by connecting private-sector help with public agencies.
organizations.source_title: FOX 11 LA: Rick Caruso launches Steadfast LA (Feb 2025)
organizations.notes: Official website not confirmed yet. Link to the news article until verified.

organizations.name: Pacific Palisades Community Council
organizations.description: The neighborhood's community council. Hosts public meetings and shares recovery updates.

organizations.name: Palisades Community Renewal Center
organizations.description: A community center serving Palisades residents during recovery.

organizations.name: PaliBu Chamber of Commerce
organizations.description: The local chamber of commerce for Palisades and Malibu businesses.

organizations.name: City of Los Angeles Wildfire Recovery
organizations.description: The city's main page for recovery information.

organizations.name: Palisades Inspections and Permitting Support Center
organizations.description: In-person help with rebuild permits and inspections.
organizations.notes: Listed at 16925 Marquez Ave, weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Confirm before going.

organizations.name: One-Stop Rebuilding Center
organizations.description: In-person rebuilding help for Palisades homeowners and businesses.
organizations.notes: Listed at 1828 Sawtelle Blvd, weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Confirm before going.

organizations.name: Councilmember Traci Park: Palisades Recovery Updates
organizations.description: Regular recovery updates from the Palisades' city council office.

organizations.name: LA County Recovery
organizations.description: Los Angeles County's recovery information and resources.
organizations.source_title: LA County Recovery: City of LA Palisades Fire recovery resources

organizations.name: 211 LA
organizations.description: A free referral line and website that points people to local services, including disaster recovery help.

organizations.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
organizations.description: Free, 24/7 crisis support. Call or text 988.

organizations.name: Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services
organizations.description: Mental health support, including programs for people recovering from the wildfires.

organizations.name: Maple Counseling
organizations.description: Counseling services, including a program with the Palisades Community Renewal Center.
